objective: Ship the perception adapter in the built wheel and add a test that fails when any runtime package in the tree is missing from the explicit setuptools list.
decision_supported: Is the install boundary the source tree? No: a wheel is what gets installed, and a package absent from the list is silently dropped.
acceptance: workbench_perception is in the packages list and the package-dir mapping.
A test fails if a runtime package is not declared.
stop_conditions: The adapter would need a dependency the image does not install.
risks_and_fallbacks: Shipping the adapter adds its imports to the installed surface; it imports only the standard library.
